notes.title: Update notes #4
notes.content:
Update notes (2/3):
 
 - Added 4 items (2 new status effects)
 - Added the option to disable projectile shadows in advanced settings
 - Killing the final boss should no longer freeze the game in some rare cases
 - Various balance changes
 - Weapons can no longer drop in lava
 - Fixed a bug causing tentacles in the last floor to spawn in walls
 - Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes #3
notes.content:
Update notes (1/30):

 - Added a new encounter
 - Added an item
 - Improved the visibility of text in the ice level
 - Fixed a bug causing final boss taking minimal damage from piercing weapons
 - Advanced settings now save upon restart
 - Added the display of range in the weapon info box

notes.title: Update notes #2
notes.content:
Update notes (1/29):

 - Added a new weapon
 - Added an indicator of the centipede's position 
 - Added advanced options, allows to modify your projectiles' opacity/lighting/particles
 - Improved the firerate system
 - Fixed rare instances of crashes 
 - Item balancing 
 - Added a quick restart, hold "R" to respawn (Only works on the first floor)

notes.title: Update notes #1
notes.content:
Post-endless mode update (1/28)

  - Endless mode now scales properly, removed additional item drops
 - The Black Dice item now correctly inflicts the burning status effect
 - Added a minimum damage cap (Can no longer heal mobs lul)
 - Added hearts/item icons on the minimap
 - Balance changes
 - Steam screenshots now function properly

Pre-endless mode update

 - Fixed visual glitches when entering/exiting rooms (like character duplicating)
 - Fixed final boss interaction with electrocution/ricochet
 - Fixed various game crashes from occuring
 - Changed projectiles colors on the 3rd floor (ice floor) to make them stand out more
 - Improved the dashing interaction near walls, for keyboard and gamepad
 - Modified the burn status effects (damage now scales with hit damage)
 - Fixed final boss lag/projectile hits getting registered multiple times
 - Some items now require interaction to pickup
 - Improved shop RNG consistency
 - Improved gamepad support
 - All settings now save upon closing the game (except for windowed/fullscreen)
 - Can no longer take damage after killing a boss 
 - Improved the ice physics
 - Various other minor bug fixes/changes

notes.title: Endless mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

As promised, here is the first content update: an end-game endless mode.
To access it, you'll have to beat the final boss. The items and and weapons you've beaten the boss with will carry on into the new mode. 

If you have any feedback, let me know in the steam discussions or the discord. 
Next update will feature new weapons, events and items!

- Moon Lens

notes.title: What's coming next?
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First off, so happy with the release (no game-breaking bugs, phew), congrats to the 2 people that already managed to beat the final boss (Megatherium and 莫笑笙歌)! 

I'm currently making an end-game mode that will make things even more interesting once you beat the final encouter: An endless mode in which you fight as long as you can with the loot you've accumulated previously. 

This will spice things up as you'll be able to "hunt" for the best loot in the base game and then battle to the death in an incredibly intense mode. 
Along with that, will also be adding new weapons and events. 
The update will drop right on time for the week-end!

Have a great day <3

- Moon Lens 


[url=https://discord.gg/pscj5GR]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Ether Loop is out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Ether Loop is now available for purchase and download, and will be running a discount launch for a week. Have fun and enjoy!

If you encounter any issues or have feedback, you can post it in the steam discussions or in this [url=https://discord.gg/pscj5GR]Discord[/url]. I will do my best to fix any issues quickly and listen to feedback!

- Moon Lens

notes.title: Ether Loop is about to release!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! Release date is approaching very quickly, [b]next Tuesday at 10 am PST[/b]. I think this is the perfect time to give you guys some info on how things will unfold post-release.

I've very recently added leaderboards rankings for the time taken to beat each boss, if you're interested in speedrunning or just competing with your friends you'll like this feature a lot! Could lead to adding a game mode geared towards that if the community enjoys it. 

I created a discord today, make sure to join if you have questions, want to provide feedback after release or participate in future events: 

[url=https://discord.gg/pscj5GR]Discord Link[/url]

As to what's planned right after release, which can change depending on community feedback:

- New weapons, items and random encounters
- The addition of a "cursed" modifier to weapons and items
- Release on Mac
- A new game mode? 
- And more!

Have a great weekend =)
